stage: S0 / M1a quick feasibility (development data only; never confirmatory)
question: Can a strong non-AI optimizer (CMA-ES) make genuinely failing development creatures walk under full_recovery_v1, with the existing 15-D controller representation? Zero-rollout dynamic-similarity transfer is assessed as well.
optimizer: walk_opt.cma_search defaults (sigma0 0.2 in [0,1] units, IPOP restarts, Hansen 2016 parameters)
recovery_rule: recovery.full_recovery_v1 (aggregate PASS >= 80% walking on 24 validation seeds under VARIATION_PRESET + verdict_v1 VERIFIED vs the unmodified original + 20 s confirmation on 24 further seeds); verdict_v1 and WalkingCriteria unchanged
body_edit_rules: joint search stays inside the existing edit-rule ratio box [0.5, 1.5] and the guided bounds; at most 4 body parameters
analysis: descriptive only: per creature x condition x checkpoint status (FULL_RECOVERY / PARTIAL_IMPROVEMENT / NOT_RECOVERED / INCONCLUSIVE_ERROR), walking fraction, verdict, rollouts. No test statistic. Informs the full M1 design and the G1 gate; does not by itself decide G1.
wording_rule: an unrecovered creature is 'not recovered within budget X under representation Y', never 'impossible'
